citations.claim: penetrates wall beyond 0.15 limit at first violating step

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.01216 to 0.001, keeping all other fields identical; smaller substep distance prevents tunneling through thin wall

explanation: Body moves at ~53 m/s with dt=0.012 split into 22 substeps. At step 1 centre is just above wall (distance +0.023), at step 2 it is 0.228 inside wall despite substepping, so discrete collision handling fails to prevent penetration when grazing the thin (0.2 thick) wall at high speed.
vision_note: The red body skims just above the right end of the thin horizontal wall across steps 0 to 1 and then sinks into it at step 2. Its bottom half is visibly overlapping the wall interior instead of remaining clear of the surface.
